topology.note: One authoritative sim instance for one match; not a concurrent-match fleet-capacity result.

accountingBoundary.downstreamVerdict: Exact UTF-8 JSON application bytes accepted by ws.send callback per recipient.
accountingBoundary.upstream: Exact UTF-8 JSON application bytes accepted by the authority plus client serialized class ledger.
accountingBoundary.manifest: Exact served canonical manifest bytes, reported separately from steady stream.

ackBaseProof.counterScope: scenario lifetime including warmup; live base fields are pre-cleanup

byteEvidence.statement: All-accepted statistics come from the exact accounting window; the bounded sample is retained only as a deterministic positional-codec attribution digest.

accountingRecipientMapping.method: Unique maximum-weight one-to-one assignment over accepted frameId:exactWireBytes tuples in the full capture; scored metrics remain measurement-window-only so zero-cadence clients receive no credit.
accountingRecipientMapping.identityProofScope: full capture including setup and warmup

cadence.authorityBoundary: Application state-pair bytes accepted by ws.send callbacks; not proof of receiver acceptance.
cadence.receiverBoundary: State pairs accepted and materialized by each test receiver inside the measured window.

fieldFreshness.measurement: Every group is projected from the same authoritative snapshot; unchanged groups retain their prior revision.

targetCadenceNormalization.method: Hold each recipient's observed accepted pair-size mix constant; scale state-pair bytes from observed cadence to configured 10 Hz; leave observed non-state bytes unchanged.
targetCadenceNormalization.admissionUse: Counterfactual guard only. A true admission also requires observed cadence >=90% of configured cadence and NORMAL overload.

modeledTransportBoundary.webSocket: Modeled unmasked server frame header: 2, 4, or 10 bytes by payload length.
modeledTransportBoundary.tls13: Modeled 22 bytes per TLS 1.3 record with a 16,384-byte plaintext cap and one WebSocket frame per record sequence.
modeledTransportBoundary.ipv4Tcp: Modeled 40-byte IPv4+TCP headers per 1,460-byte TCP payload segment; excludes options, ACK-only packets, loss, and retransmit.

recoveryAnalysis.interpretation: Unexpected recovery in a normal window fails correctness. Churn results must be read with the injected fault log; retries never satisfy cadence or admission.

authority.percentileScope: bounded runtime rolling ring; reset after warmup by evidence-only endpoint

publisherCandidateEncodeAggregate.measurementScope: authority lifetime including warmup; adapter codec counters reset with evidence windows

publisherCandidateEncodeMsPerFrameByInte.scope: Distribution of per-frame mean encode milliseconds across consecutive one-second evidence samples; not an individual-call latency distribution.

adapterEncodeMsPerFrameByInterval.scope: Distribution of per-frame mean encode milliseconds across consecutive one-second evidence samples; not an individual-call latency distribution.

codec.boundary: Authority codec aggregates expose exact calls/bytes/total/mean; bounded p50/p95/p99/max rows distribute per-frame means across consecutive one-second samples. Client decode is an individual-frame distribution. Stage profiler remains OFF.

performance.clientApplyBoundary: ClientDeltaReceiver.receive over positional text: positional decode, validate, materialize, hash/ACK construction, and apply; not render CPU.

memory.ledgerLimitation: Authority process memory includes the guarded replication-accounting ledger and cannot isolate product-only retention.

ackRejectDiagnostics.orderScope: global arrival order within one match authority lifetime; not per-recipient causal order

sharedPublicWork.scope: one authority instance and one authoritative target tick

sharedPublicWork.scope: one authority instance and one authoritative tick

positionalJson.measurementScope: authority lifetime including warmup; adapter codec counters reset with evidence windows

limitations: no hosted fleet, WSS, WAN, packet retransmission, compression, AOI, binary codec, or 24-96-client claim

comparisonToS6PreparedDiagnostic.method: S6 alternating short paired diagnostic aggregate; not a five-minute canonical product run.
